name: services/blobbox/user
description: Get storage usage statistics for a given user. Note, that user stats do not include blobs uploaded by other consumers! You have access only to stats related to your application.
brief_description: Get storage usage statistics for a given user.

arguments.name: user_id
arguments.description:
ID of the user. If you provide an invalid user ID, you will get a
	HTTP 400 error.

arguments.name: fields
arguments.description: Pipe-separated list of fields (as in the consumer method).

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns: A dictionary of the same structure as the one returned in the consumer method. However, all the values will be computed against blobs uploaded by matched users only.
